title: Next Greater Numerically Balanced Number
summary: Find the smallest numerically balanced number greater than a given integer n, ensuring each digit d appears exactly d times in the number.
statement: Find the smallest numerically balanced number greater than a given integer n, ensuring each digit d appears exactly d times in the number.
constraints: A positive integer is balanced when every digit d appearing in it occurs exactly d times.
Return the smallest balanced integer strictly greater than n.
hints: The search range is small enough to test successive integers directly.
For each candidate, count its decimal digits and require each present digit’s frequency to equal its value.
Increment from n+1 until all(text.count(d)==int(d) for d in set(text)).
Candidates are inspected in increasing order, the predicate is exactly numerical balance, and therefore the first passing value is the required minimum.
editorial: Candidates are inspected in increasing order, the predicate is exactly numerical balance, and therefore the first passing value is the required minimum.

tests.explanation: The smallest balanced number greater than one is 22, where digit two appears twice.
The next balanced number is 1333: one occurs once and three occurs three times.
